info.name: Smart Task Manager API
info.description:
Generated from docs/swagger.json by tools/export-api-docs.ps1.

Sign in with 'POST /api/auth/login' first: it stores the access token in {{accessToken}}, which every request sends as a Bearer token. Create requests store new ids in {{userId}}, {{projectId}} and {{taskId}}. The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie that Postman keeps automatically. Requests marked 'No Auth' are anonymous.

item.name: Auth
POST /api/auth/register - Creates a new account with the TeamMember role

request.description: Creates a new account with the TeamMember role. Rate limited per IP.

item.name: POST /api/auth/login - Signs in and starts a session

request.description: Signs in and starts a session. Sets the refresh token cookie. Rate limited per IP.

item.name: POST /api/auth/refresh - Exchanges the refresh token cookie for a new access token and a rotated refresh token

request.description:
Exchanges the refresh token cookie for a new access token and a rotated refresh token.
Presenting an already-rotated token revokes the whole session.

item.name: POST /api/auth/logout - Ends the session: revokes the refresh token family and clears the cookie

request.description: Ends the session: revokes the refresh token family and clears the cookie. Always succeeds.

item.name: Users
GET /api/users - Lists users

request.description: Lists users. Search matches name or email; sortBy: name, email, role, createdAt.

item.name: GET /api/users/lookup - Active users for adding project members or assigning tasks

request.description:
Active users for adding project members or assigning tasks. Search matches name or email;
sortBy: name, email; pageSize up to 50.

item.name: PUT /api/users/{id}/role - Changes another user's role

request.description: Changes another user's role. You cannot change your own role or demote the last active Admin.

item.name: PUT /api/users/{id}/status - Activates or deactivates another user

request.description:
Activates or deactivates another user. Deactivation ends their sessions. You cannot deactivate
yourself or the last active Admin.

item.name: Projects
GET /api/projects - Lists the projects the caller can see
POST /api/projects - Creates a project owned by the caller

request.description: Creates a project owned by the caller.

item.name: GET /api/projects/{id} - Project details, including members

request.description: Project details, including members.

item.name: PUT /api/projects/{id}
DELETE /api/projects/{id} - Soft-deletes the project and its tasks

request.description: Soft-deletes the project and its tasks.

item.name: POST /api/projects/{id}/members - Adds an active user to the project

request.description: Adds an active user to the project.

item.name: DELETE /api/projects/{id}/members/{userId} - Removes a member; their tasks in this project become unassigned

request.description: Removes a member; their tasks in this project become unassigned.

item.name: Tasks
GET /api/tasks - Lists tasks across all projects the caller can see

request.description:
Lists tasks across all projects the caller can see. Those are the projects they own or are a
member of (Admin: all projects); each row includes the project name. Same search, filters and
sorting as the project task list, plus projectId (a project the caller cannot see gives an
empty list) and overdue=true (due before today, UTC, and ToDo or InProgress).

item.name: GET /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks - Lists the project's tasks

request.description:
Lists the project's tasks. Search matches title and description; filters: status, priority,
assigneeId, dueFrom/dueTo (inclusive; undated tasks excluded). sortBy: title, priority, status,
dueDate (undated last), createdAt. Without sortBy: highest priority, then earliest due date.

item.name: POST /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks - Creates a task (status To Do)

body.raw:
{
    "title":  "Write the release notes",
    "description":  "Summarize the changes in this release for customers.",
    "priority":  "Low",
    "dueDate":  "2026-12-31",
    "assigneeId":  "{{userId}}"
}

request.description: Creates a task (status To Do). Priority defaults to Medium; the assignee must be an active project member.

item.name: GET /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}
PUT /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId} - Updates title, description, priority and due date (null clears the due date)

request.description: Updates title, description, priority and due date (null clears the due date).

item.name: DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId} - Soft-deletes the task

request.description: Soft-deletes the task.

item.name: PUT /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/assignee - Assigns or reassigns the task to an active project member

request.description: Assigns or reassigns the task to an active project member.

item.name: DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/assignee
PUT /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/status - Changes the status

request.description:
Changes the status. A cancelled task can only be reopened to ToDo, and only by the owner or an
Admin. Completing sets completedAt; any other status clears it.

item.name: Dashboard

GET /api/dashboard - Totals, tasks by status and priority, completed vs pending (pending = ToDo + InProgress;
cancelled counts as neither), overdue count, and pending tasks due in the next 7 days (UTC)

request.description:
Totals, tasks by status and priority, completed vs pending (pending = ToDo + InProgress;
cancelled counts as neither), overdue count, and pending tasks due in the next 7 days (UTC).

item.name: Ai

POST /api/ai/improve-description - Suggests an improved task description: corrected grammar, clearer and more professional wording,
expanded short text, and actionable steps
Health
GET /health - Health check (database)

request.description: Anonymous and not rate limited. 200 when healthy, 503 when a check (database) fails.
